name: FND_LIST_SEARCH_KEYWORDS
description: This table is created to store list search keywords submitted by the logged in user in fusion apps when using the fnd:listSearch component.

columns.name: LIST_SEARCH_KEYWORDS_ID
columns.description: Primary identifier for list search keyword row.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: User name of the user doing the search.

columns.name: CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: The context code of the list search in use.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The object type of the list search in use.

columns.name: KEYWORDS
columns.description: The keywords used in a search performed by the user.

columns.name: SEARCH_COUNT
columns.description: The number of times this keyword search has been performed by the user for the context code and object type.

columns.name: RESULT_COUNT
columns.description: The number of times this keyword search has been performed by the user for the context code and object type.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
